semantics.clock: All sequential logic updates on the positive edge, as explicitly specified.
semantics.load: At each positive edge, active high load synchronously replaces q with data; otherwise advance one Rule 110 step.
semantics.neighbors: For cell i, left is old q[i+1], center old q[i], right old q[i-1]. Out-of-range neighbors are zero.
semantics.initialization: No reset or initial state is specified; leave state uninitialized until synchronous load. No required defined evolution before load.

verification.oracle: Independent per-cell case lookup of the original eight-row truth table using a saved pre-edge vector.
verification.sampling: Drive on falling edges, check unchanged before rising edge, sample after rising-edge nonblocking updates.
verification.coverage: All eight neighborhoods, both zero boundaries, all-zero/all-one/alternating loads, isolated endpoint and interior cells, repeated loads and randomized loads/evolution.
verification.termination: Fatal mismatches, bounded timeout, PASS only after all checks.

specification_ambiguities: Power-up q is unspecified: no reset or initialization is provided. Verification of defined Rule 110 transitions begins after a load.
